stat_test: Friedman test on mean rankings of the 4 oversamplers per classifier/metric (Table 4, all significant), then Holm's method adjusting p-values of paired tests with G-SMOTE as control vs NO OVERSAMPLING, RANDOM OVERSAMPLING and SMOTE (Table 5); a = 0.05

win_claim.quote: The results show that G-SMOTE performs significantly better compared to the other methods.

notes: Paper contains NO per-dataset results table; rows left empty. Table 1 (PDF p.18-19) lists the 69 datasets (13 UCI, 13 KEEL, 2 simulated MANDELON, plus undersampled variants with IR x2 '(2)' and x3 '(3)'): HEART, LIVER, WINE, PIMA, BREAST TISSUE, IRIS, GLASS, YEAST 1, HEART (2), LIVER (2), HABERMAN, WINE (2), VEHICLE, PIMA (2), HEART (3), BREAST TISSUE (2), IRIS (2), GLASS (2), LIVER (3), WINE (3), YEAST 1 (2), NEW THYROID 1, NEW THYROID 2, ECOLI, EUCALYPTUS, HABERMAN (2), PIMA (3), SEGMENTATION, IRIS (3), GLASS (3), VEHICLE (2), YEAST 1 (3), YEAST 3, HABERMAN (3), PAGE BLOCKS 0, VEHICLE (3), VOWEL, NEW THYROID 2 (2), NEW THYROID 1 (2), ECOLI (2), LED, EUCALYPTUS (2), SEGMENTATION (2), LIBRAS, PAGE BLOCKS 1 3, YEAST 3 (2), ECOLI (3), DERMATOLOGY, EUCALYPTUS (3), PAGE BLOCKS 0 (2), SEGMENTATION (3), VOWEL (2), LED (2), YEAST 3 (3), PAGE BLOCKS 0 (3), MANDELON 1, MANDELON 2, YEAST 4, VOWEL (3), YEAST 5, YEAST 6, MANDELON 1 (2), MANDELON 2 (2), YEAST 4 (2), YEAST 5 (2), MANDELON 1 (3), MANDELON 2 (3), YEAST 4 (3), YEAST 6 (2). Paper text says 'MANDELON' (sic, not MADELON). The paper's full results CSV (wide_optimal.csv on GitHub) is external and was not fetched; per-dataset values would have to come from there if needed. summary_rows: first entry is the chosen LR G-MEAN; all 12 classifier/metric combinations from Table 2 and Table 3 plus SMOTE-column Holm p-values from Table 5 are included (extra keys no_oversampling / random_oversampling hold the other baselines). Hyper-parameters tuned (best CV score reported) for both SMOTE (k in {3,5}) and G-SMOTE (grid of selection strategy, k, truncation, deformation). Text extracted cleanly; no rendering needed. PDF page numbers count the cover sheet as p.1.
